name: DNA Admin
description: Spree admin, CMS and API. Heroku review apps build from heroku.yml (the Dockerfile), the same as production.

AWS_REGION_NAME.description: Active Storage builds its S3 client at boot, so a region is needed even without real keys. Set the AWS_* vars on the pipeline's review stage to give review apps working uploads.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Admin user created by the postdeploy script.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: That admin's password. Read it from the review app's config vars.
